fact: Ordonnance n°2012-016/P-RM of 19 March 2012 creates the Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité (AMANORM) as a public administrative body with legal personality and financial autonomy, charged with implementing national policy on standardisation and quality promotion and with creating and managing the national conformity mark; it names no national standard on information technology or data.

ISO's member record names AMANORM (Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité) as Mali's national standards body, an ISO full member body; the page carries no event date, so the published date 2026-09-03 is used.

Le Rônier reports that the 14th ordinary board session of AMANORM, Mali's standards and quality promotion agency, met on 29 January 2026 under the Ministry of Industry and Commerce's secretary-general and adopted a 2026 budget of 243,306,303 FCFA against 318,369,036 FCFA in 2025.
